name: Chinese Chicken Salad with Napa Cabbage, Carrots & Tortilla Strips

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Cut tortillas into thin strips and transfer to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat. Arrange in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 large flour tortillas
3 tsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and bake until golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, ginger, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, and crushed red pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tbsp honey
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry cabbage, carrots, and cilantro. Thinly slice cabbage into shreds. Trim ends, peel, and coarsely grate carrots. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add everything to bowl with dressing and toss.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium head napa cabbage
3 medium carrots
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place salad on a plate and top with tortilla chips and chicken. Enjoy!
